respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture described by Majid Al Futtaim represents 'The Grid', a centralized data lake and analytics platform. It collects data from multiple sources and applications across 14 countries, processes it via Kafka and EMR, stores it in an S3 Data Lake, manages metadata via MetaManager on EKS (with Elasticsearch and Neo4j), and serves analytical consumers (RDS, Vertica, Data Analysts/Scientists). All components shown on the whiteboard and described in the audio are captured with their respective connections, notes, and evidence.
